shared_elements: low-relief motifs carved on a tall monolithic upright
circular disc/ring motif set on the body of the block
horizontal band(s) dividing the surface into upper and lower zones
repeated small motifs arranged in a row near the top
schematic anthropomorphic reading of the whole block (head/shoulder zone above, body below)
justification: Both are upright monoliths whose surfaces carry shallow, flat, schematic relief organised into an upper zone of repeated motifs and a lower zone divided by horizontal banding, and each includes a plain circular disc set on the body of the block. But the depicted content diverges sharply: A shows a register of animals in profile (birds, a quadruped, snake-like and chevron patterning) with arch/omega signs above, whereas B depicts a single frontal anthropomorphic figure with headdress, ear ornaments, folded arms, pectoral disc and belted garment, with no animals at all.
